name: Flush DNS Cache
description: Clears the local DNS client cache to remove outdated entries and ensure fresh lookups.

description_i18n.en: Clears the local DNS client cache to remove outdated entries and ensure fresh lookups.
description_i18n.de: Leert den lokalen DNS-Cache, um veraltete Einträge zu entfernen und frische Abfragen sicherzustellen.
description_i18n.fr: Vidange le cache du client DNS pour supprimer les entrées obsolètes et garantir des requêtes fraîches.

warnings.title: required
warnings.message: This tweak requires an elevated administrator session to apply changes and flush the cache successfully

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the Clear-DnsClientCache command to flush stored domain name resolutions from memory This action is a one-shot maintenance task that does not alter registry keys or install persistent services
